config.notes: Pre-specified before the run. Same estimators, seed formula, and isotropic noise as configs/recalibration.json, applied to eight public numeric binary tables. Calibrators are fit on clean training rows only. Contrasts of interest: logistic isotonic minus baseline (Brier and ROC-AUC), forest sigmoid minus baseline (Brier), logistic sigmoid minus baseline (Brier), at sigma 0 and sigma 1. The dataset name is not part of the seed. WDBC rows are checked against the primary recalibration file.

notes.question: Calibrators are fit on clean training rows only and scored under isotropic Gaussian feature noise. The pre-specified contrasts are isotonic minus baseline for logistic regression (Brier and ROC-AUC) and sigmoid minus baseline for the random forest and for logistic regression (Brier), at sigma 0 and sigma 1.
notes.seed: Identical to the WDBC recalibration seed. The dataset name is not an input.
